column1: # Outcomes of unreadable words of rec in the heartbeat rec/heartbeats/<name> (V/02.4 Н1.8, V/02.5 Н1.7, V/02.8 Н1.2, V/02.9 Н1.3, Н1.10) for the subsystem readers; a wholly unreadable heartbeat is the Platform family heartbeats. column3: ingest of a neighbour not in form: not read, rather than «no receiver» — on this pass not a neighbour, the stream is not pushed to it; the next heartbeat — again

stream of the card's recorder not in form: not read, rather than absent — the camera is silent, the catch-up recording window decides
